units.source_text: 有时我送绫子到大门口，忽然想说：不知怎的，现在让你回去，我总放心不下，你还是在我家待一会儿吧。

en.t: Sometimes, when I walked Ayako to the front gate, I suddenly felt like saying: somehow, I cannot feel easy about letting you go home now, so why don't you stay at my house a little longer?

units.source_text: 不到十五分钟，绫子淌出了许多鼻血。

en.t: In less than fifteen minutes, Ayako began bleeding heavily from the nose.

units.source_text: 要是在半路上，一定很不好办吧。

en.t: If it had happened on the way, it surely would have been very difficult to deal with.
